role: The collidable non-living entities in the client pick other than the large fireball (clientworld.c's copy, combat.c's entry): EntityTracker for falling blocks, primed TNT, ender crystals, paintings and item frames (the spawn packet at spawnEntityInWorld, the start-watching S12, sendLocationToAllClients' S15/S16/S17/S18 and velocity S12s, the S13 before or after the player's update), the WorldClient copies those packets build and each copy's client onUpdate, the client's own attack on a copy, and the server's C02 attack on these kinds (a hanging entity broken, a crystal hit). It also tracks the ender dragon (a living, the IAnimals branch) and keeps its client copy and parts for the pick.

structs.name: pickobj
structs.java: the WorldClient copy of one entity

structs.name: pickobj_state
structs.java: the tracker entries, EntityPlayerMP.destroyedItemsNetCache, the packets in flight, the client copies

structs.name: pickobj_dragon
structs.java: the client EntityDragon: dragon_state plus setPositionAndRotation2's target and the watcher's health

gpu: function send and spawn_copy: realloc of the packet queue and the copies array
function pickobj_bind: calloc of the state (once per run)
functions trk_find, obj_find: linear searches by id
notes: Evidence: out/java/snapshots/pick-shapes-s1 (the gravel column's falling blocks under the crosshair, a painting and a frame punched). The large fireball moved to master's clientworld.c/combat.c path at the merge with lane/netherscen. The dragon and its parts have no client copy (a follow-up). pickobj_client_objs and pickobj_client_dragon hand the client copies to the live client's draw (read only, between ticks: csrc/play/clientents.c). pickobj_client_pump_positions runs the copies' setPositionAndRotation2 at updateController's place in runTick: its collision query puts a stair's shared bounds back to the full cube before the use's placement check (lane/rlfuzz2, rf-s1-814); EntityArrow's override only sets the position.
